sentences.text:
27.03.2019 (INDORE):
 Shri Ankit Premchandani, learned counsel for the  applicant.
 Shri Yogesh Gupta, learned GA for   respondent/State.

While considering IA no.1000/19, which is an application for suspension of sentence of the applicant, it transpired that instead of filing a criminal revision against the impugned order pronounced by the learned District Judge in criminal appeal, an appeal would have been filed as per the provision of section 71(6) of the Food Safety and Standards Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant prays for time to make submissions regarding applicability of section 71(6) of the Act.
As prayed, matter be listed on 01.04.2019.

(SHAILENDRA SHUKLA) JUDGE hk/
